description.zh: 用嵌入包的 tio 打开串口终端：搜索框里选端口、按 Enter 启动、再 Enter 停止，波特率有快捷项；数据位、校验、停止位、流控、远程共享与默认值在独立窗口里。独立窗口可确认开启双向远程串口共享，局域网客户端可读写串口。
description.en: Open a serial terminal with the bundled tio: pick the port in the search box, Enter starts and Enter again stops, with baud-rate shortcuts. Data bits, parity, stop bits, flow control, remote sharing and defaults live in the standalone window, which can explicitly confirm bidirectional remote serial sharing; LAN clients can read and write to the serial device.

hint.zh: Enter 启动，再 Enter 停止；波特率在这里选，其余参数在独立窗口
hint.en: Enter starts, Enter again stops; pick the baud rate here, the rest is in the window

ai.description: Configure and launch the bundled tio serial terminal. One launch row per port names the COMn and its /dev/ttyS(n-1) mapping; Enter starts tio after six pre-launch checks and Enter again stops the session this plugin started. A baud-rate row offers the common rates, and a row showing the whole configuration (serial parameters and the resolved backend) opens the standalone window, where data bits, parity, stop bits, flow control, remote sharing, the shared port and the defaults live. The backend preference (auto, Windows Terminal or conhost) is on the plugin's settings card in WinShun. The standalone window can explicitly confirm bidirectional remote serial sharing on TCP 54321; remote clients can write to the device.

hint.zh: 通过 WinShun MCP 读写用户已开启共享的会话
hint.en: Read and write user-shared sessions through WinShun MCP

ai.description: WinShun MCP command for reading status or serial bytes from, and sending bytes to, a session that the user started in the standalone window with sharing explicitly enabled. This command never opens a port or enables sharing. Use status, read COMn --format hex|ascii --from CURSOR --max BYTES, or send COMn --format hex|ascii --data VALUE. Send rows are plans; the _run tool must be called with the same query and item id, and the session and socket generation are checked again before writing.

query.description: status, read COMn, or send COMn with format and data options

hint.zh: COMn，映射到 /dev/ttyS(n-1)；留空用本机第一个端口。搜索框和独立窗口改的是同一个值
hint.en: COMn, mapped to /dev/ttyS(n-1); empty uses the machine's first port. The search box and the window edit the same value

hint.zh: tio 3.9 支持的正整数，默认 115200；搜索框的快捷项与独立窗口都改这里
hint.en: A positive rate tio 3.9 supports, default 115200; the search box's shortcuts and the window edit this same value

hint.zh: auto 优先 wt.exe，没有则 conhost；选了这台机器没有的后端会按 auto 的顺序回退，偏好本身不变
hint.en: auto prefers wt.exe and falls back to conhost; a pinned backend this machine lacks falls back in the same order, and the preference itself is kept
